fields.name: passage_count
fields.description: The number of completed target-center passages by the cube up to and including this decision's final observation. Count passages in both directions, including during preparation; do not count proximity alone. A passage occurs when cube x minus target x changes sign along the continuous motion. Initialize to 0. The values by decision step are: episode 23: 0,1,2,3,4; episode 32: 0,1,2,3,4; episode 66: 0,0,1,1; episode 94: 0,0,1,2,2; episode 99: 0,0,1,1. e.g. 2

fields.name: last_side
fields.description: The cube's most recently observed nonzero side of the target center, represented as -1 when cube x is smaller than target x and 1 when it is larger. If exactly equal, retain the preceding nonzero side; use 0 if none has yet been observed. Record the side at the decision's final observation, not the side expected after its selected command. e.g. -1

fields.name: motion_history
fields.description: An ordered list of timestamped cube x observations from execution up to and including this decision's final observation. At the first decision, record all execution observations shown, including the initial execution observation; exclude demonstration observations. At each later decision, preserve previous entries and append newly shown execution observations chronologically, keeping only one sample for any repeated timestamp. Never include future observations or predicted command outcomes. Each entry contains a timestamp and a scalar cube x measurement, not a spatial coordinate pair. Serialize the field as list text with single-quoted keys, key order 'time' then 'cube_x', and one space after each colon and comma. Do not include extra outer quotation marks within the value. Use [] for an empty list. This representation does not change the observations retained. e.g. [{'time': 0, 'cube_x': 47}, {'time': 16, 'cube_x': 80}, {'time': 32, 'cube_x': 147}]
